user.title: Starlink Train Watch
user.description: Uses Home Assistant’s home location. Set a minimum predicted satellite count and the maximum time between the first and last satellite peaks. There is no fixed maximum satellite count: a launch containing 27 tracked satellites can produce a candidate containing only 4 qualifying satellites. Predictions do not guarantee naked-eye visibility.

data_description.min_satellites: Examples: 3 includes smaller groups; 10 requires at least ten qualifying satellites from the same launch. Default: 3. There is no fixed upper limit tied to SpaceX launch sizes.
data_description.max_span_seconds: Examples: 60 requires all member peaks within one minute; 180 allows three minutes; 300 allows five minutes. Smaller values prefer more compact groups, not necessarily simultaneous visibility. Default: 180.
data_description.min_elevation: Example: 25 excludes low passes; 40 requires a higher pass. Default: 25 degrees. Buildings and terrain are not modelled.
data_description.max_sun_altitude: Example: -6 allows darker twilight; -12 requires a darker sky and may produce fewer candidates. Default: -6 degrees.
data_description.max_age_days: Example: 3 selects newer launches; 7 includes launches up to a week old. Older groups may be more dispersed. Default: 7 days.

error.invalid_options: Use elevation 0–85°, Sun altitude −18 to −1°, launch age 1–14 days, spread 30–600 seconds and an integer minimum satellite count of at least 3.
